rules.accepted_credit_types: Counseling-related courses offered or approved by ACA, Alaska Counseling Association, APA, ASWB, NASW, AAMFT, NBCC, Alaska Commission for Behavioral Health Certification, NAADAC, ASCA, Association for Play Therapy and other listed bodies; accredited university postgraduate courses (1 semester credit = 15 h); cross-disciplinary courses; presenting/publishing (max 10 h); up to 15 h of other non-preapproved training
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 20 hours if licensed under 12 months of the period, 30 hours if 12 to under 18 months, 40 hours if 18 months or more.
rules.audit_note: The Board may audit renewals after each biennial period; proof due within 30 days. Keep records 3 years.

topics.who: Approved counselor supervisors (certification renewal); can count toward the 40 hours

rules.notes: At least 20 hours must be synchronous courses/seminars; no more than half may be correspondence, video or other individual study. Max 12 hours in any 24-hour period. Current licenses expire Oct 31, 2027.
